description: Golden dataset for memory-extraction quality benchmarking. Transcripts mirror production pipeline shape (role/content turn pairs with event metadata); ground truth is by construction, scored deterministically. v2.1.0: graded core/details/metadata credit, expect_absent explicit-null checks, occurred-prefix lists, multi_chunk pipeline scenario. All names, hosts, and domains are placeholders.
conversation_context: conversation between Alice (AI assistant) and Bob (user)
retain_mission: This bank serves an AI personal assistant (Alice) that is a personal assistant, debugs infrastructure, deploys services, and manages homelab systems on the homeserver (home server) for a human owner (the human owner). Prioritize world facts: system state, configuration decisions, learnings, discoveries, and outcomes. When the speaker discovers or observes something about the world (software behavior, errors, fixes, architecture, hobbies, food, travel), tag it as fact_kind=world and fact_type=world — NOT as an assistant action. Only tag as fact_kind=assistant when the speaker themselves performed a deliberate action worth remembering. For the why field, explain why the fact MATTERS long-term, not why the speaker said it. STRICTLY consolidate: multiple observations about the same topic MUST become ONE fact, not separate entries.

scenarios.description: Workhorse v2: infra session with decisions, a backup with exact time+size+transport details, deployment facts, a standing rule, an alert fix, and a deadline RETRACTION (renewal moved 12th → 19th; old date may appear as context, new date is the core).
turns: Bob: hey alice, did the backup to the backup VPS finish last night? i saw an alert at like 2am

Alice: Yes — the nightly the homeserver backup completed at 02:14 and synced 1.2 TB to the the backup VPS VPS over WireGuard. The 2am alert was the Uptime Kuma heartbeat flapping while Borg was compacting; the job itself was green. I added a 30-minute grace window to that monitor so the flap stops paging you.
Bob: good. K2 bench runs on the 3080 tonight after my session, and remind me about the example.net renewal, it lapses on the 12th
Alice: K2 3.7B bench queued on the gaming rig for tonight after your session, results to the wiki. Calendar reminder set for the example.net renewal before September 12.
Bob: update on that — the renewal date moved, registrar says the 19th now, not the 12th
Alice: Updated: example.net renewal deadline is now September 19, moved from the 12th. I've shifted the reminder and the three-days-ahead ping accordingly.
Bob: last thing, write it down again: cost estimates go to my personal email only, never the client one. that slipped in the relay thread
Alice: Written down as a hard rule: cost estimates to your personal address only, never the client email. Flagged in the runbook so every future draft checks the recipient first.

checks.note: Consolidation may merge K2 bench + renewal into fewer facts; item matching is per-fact so merged facts still score.

scenarios.description: Pure filler v2: greetings, body complaints, mic tests, stream-of-consciousness. Correct output is ZERO facts. Harder bait than v1 (physical complaints, mic checks) but still unambiguously transient.
turns: Alice: Morning, Bob. Coffee first or fires first?
Bob: coffee first. ugh my back is killing me from sitting, gotta fix my chair height or something
Alice: Noted on the back — stand and stretch between fires, Bob.
Bob: anyway just testing the mic on the new headset, one two, check check, sounds fine
Alice: Levels read clean on my side too.
Bob: lol ok anyway anyway, talk later

checks.note: Any emitted fact is junk. Physical complaints and mic tests are bait but transient — the retain mission skips process chatter.

scenarios.description: TWO threads, each repeated three times (E4B quant incident; Denver flight details). Rules demand ONE fact per thread = 2 facts total, with detail strings spread across mentions.
turns: Bob: the e4b qat quant produced malformed retain json again today, twice now
Alice: Logged — two malformed-JSON retains from the E4B QAT quant today. Watching for a third before calling it a pattern.
Bob: and we're flying into denver for launch week, booked that this morning
Alice: Denver flights booked for launch week. Noted.
Bob: third malformed json just now, on the marinara game state
Alice: Three episodes now — that's a pattern. E4B QAT quant is dropping malformed JSON across retain and Marinara. Recommend a restart plus dropping temp from 1.0 to 0.7.
Bob: the denver return leg is the red-eye btw
Alice: Noted — Denver return is the red-eye.
Bob: restarted the server and dropped the temp like you said, e4b looks stable
Alice: Confirmed stable after restart + temp 0.7. Recap: three malformed-JSON episodes across retain and Marinara today, resolved by restart plus temperature drop; monitoring for recurrence.
Bob: cool. denver stuff is all set then
Alice: Denver is set: flights booked this morning for launch week, returning on the red-eye.

checks.note: Exactly one consolidated fact per thread. Fragments are punished by precision (yield/emitted) and by the max_facts cap.

scenarios.description: Temporal v2 with traps: 'yesterday' → Sep 2, the mechanic MOVED from the 11th to the 18th (new date is core, old date is bonus detail), 'this coming monday' → Sep 7, 'since june'. Events must carry resolved occurred_start ISO dates.
turns: Bob: the pihole dns thing from yesterday took me three hours, turned out to be the conditional forwarding loop
Alice: Logged: yesterday, September 2, the Pi-hole conditional-forwarding loop cost three hours; fix documented in the network runbook.
Bob: the launch prep review is this coming monday, block it
Alice: Blocked: launch prep review on Monday, September 7.
Bob: the mechanic friday week for the brake inspection
Alice: The mechanic appointment for the brake inspection on Friday, September 11 — calendar set with a day-before reminder.
Bob: update, they moved the the mechanic to the 18th instead of the 11th
Alice: Updated: the mechanic moved to Friday, September 18 (was the 11th). Reminder shifted.
Bob: and remember ive been off caffeine since june, relevant for the sleep stuff
Alice: Noted: off caffeine since June 2026 — saved as relevant context for the sleep discussion.

checks.note: Unresolved relative dates in event facts trip the banned-pattern check ('yesterday' etc). Moved-appointment: emitting BOTH dates as separate facts = fragmentation penalty.

scenarios.description: Five distinct single-mention facts with numeric precision traps (60/40 not 40/60; 21st vs 14th; Nov 6). Pure recall + detail retention.
turns: Bob: four things, fast. one, the homelab got a new ups, a cyberpower cp1500, swapped in this morning
Alice: Logged: CyberPower CP1500 UPS installed in the homelab this morning.
Bob: two, halloween party is booked for october 31 at Margot's place again
Alice: Halloween party: October 31, at Margot's place, same as last year.
Bob: three, finished rebalancing the portfolio, went 60/40 stocks bonds, was 70/30
Alice: Portfolio rebalanced to 60/40 stocks/bonds from 70/30.
Bob: four, my sister's birthday is the 21st, get the gift shipped by the 14th
Alice: Sister's birthday on the 21st; gift must ship by the 14th. Reminder set.
Bob: oh and five, austin flights are booked for november 6
Alice: Austin flights booked for November 6. All five logged.

checks.note: Five distinct topics — no consolidation possible. Numeric strings are direction-sensitive: '40/60' does not match '60/40'.

scenarios.description: Rule 8 naming (Alice/Bob, never 'the assistant/user'), fact_type=assistant for Alice's own actions with occurred dates, and the prompt's own COREFERENCE example: 'my roommate — emily —' + cat name must resolve to Emily in the fact.
turns: Bob: did you end up fixing the relay dev server like you said this morning?
Alice: Yes — I rebuilt the Relay dev server on port 5173 this morning and verified the hot-reload loop end to end. It had been crash-looping since your last npm update.
Bob: thank god. and the wiki page for it?
Alice: I also updated the Relay wiki page with the new port and the crash-loop fix notes.
Bob: unrelated, my roommate — emily — is watching my place next week while im in austin. her cat is called miso
Alice: Noted: Emily (your roommate) is house-sitting next week while you're in Austin, and her cat is called Miso.

checks.note: 'The assistant/the user/the AI' in what/who fields trips the banned pattern. Coreference: fact should name Emily, not 'my roommate' unlinked.

scenarios.description: NEW: corrections and cancellations. Launch moved 15th → 22nd (new date core, old date context-detail); webcam return SCRATCHED (keeping the Logitech). Stale versions emitted as standalone facts are fragmentation/junk. Tests belief-update discipline.
turns: Bob: the relay launch is set for september 15
Alice: Logged: Relay launch set for September 15.
Bob: wait, update — launch moved to september 22, the 15th is dead
Alice: Updated: Relay launch is now September 22 (was the 15th). Calendar shifted.
Bob: also im returning the logitech webcam, got the insta360 coming
Alice: Noted: returning the Logitech webcam, Insta360 on the way.
Bob: scratch that, the logitech arrived and it's actually fine, keeping it, insta360 cancelled
Alice: Reversed: keeping the Logitech webcam, Insta360 cancelled. Current state: Logitech stays.

checks.note: The stale 'returning webcam' or 'launch on the 15th' emitted as separate facts = over-extraction. Cancelling the Insta360 is context, not a required fact.

scenarios.description: NEW v2.1: facts spread across three separate chunks (production extracts each chunk independently then merges). Tests cross-chunk consolidation, no duplication, and late-arriving corrections.
chunks: Bob: the backup system is getting an upgrade next week, moving from borg to restic
Alice: Logged: backup migration from Borg to Restic planned for next week.
Bob: update on the backup thing, the restic migration is done, finished this morning
Alice: Confirmed: backup migration to Restic completed this morning.
Bob: oh and the restic repo is on the new nas, 8tb, not the backup VPS anymore
Alice: Noted: Restic repository now lives on the new 8TB NAS, no longer the backup VPS.

checks.note: Merged-pipeline scoring: one consolidated backup fact expected (migration done + target change may merge or split). Cross-chunk duplication (same fact twice) is punished by yield. 'Not the backup VPS anymore' must NOT produce a stale 'backups go to the backup VPS' fact.

banned_output_patterns.note: Temporal rule: relative expressions must resolve to absolute dates in event facts. Restricted to scenarios with dated events.
